title: Square bracket in dialogue is read as a variable
fix: Escape it as \[ , or close the interpolation with a real variable name.

title: Text tag opened and never closed
fix: Close it, for example {i}...{/i}, or escape a literal brace as \{.

title: define used for a variable that changes during play
fix: Use default instead of define so the value is saved and rolled back.

title: persistent value read with no default
fix: Add default persistent.NAME = ... so a first-time player does not read None.

title: Tab used for indentation
fix: Ren'Py indentation must be spaces. Replace the tab with spaces.

title: config.developer is hard-set to True
fix: Set config.developer = "auto" so the console and dev menu stay out of the build.

title: config.console is left True
fix: Remove the line or set it False before you build the distribution.

title: config.autoreload is left True
fix: Leave autoreload to developer mode; do not pin it True in a shipped build.

title: config.save_directory is not set
fix: Define config.save_directory once and never change it, so saves survive a rename.

title: config.version is still the template placeholder
fix: Set the real version; storefronts and crash reports read this string.

title: Build rules do not exclude .rpy source
fix: Add build.classify('game/**.rpy', None) if you do not want readable script source in the distribution.

title: Deprecated im.* image manipulator
fix: Replace with a Transform or a Composite displayable.

title: config.image_cache_size is the removed setting
fix: Use config.image_cache_size_mb, which is measured in megabytes.

title: Asset path will not resolve outside your machine
fix: Use a relative, forward-slash path inside game/, e.g. "images/bg/harbour.webp".
